messages:
Samir: Hi team 10 chipped a tooth during a conference in Mexico City. Dentist wants payment up front. Can Redwood provide a verification letter or pay the clinic directly? I have the estimate in MXN.

People Ops: Ouch, sorry Samir. We can email a verification letter to the clinic and start a Direct Pay review. Quick Qs: do you want us to try direct-pay (may take longer) or prefer reimbursement to you? Please upload the estimate and clinic contact.

Samir: Estimate uploaded (est_mx_01.jpg). Clinic: Clinica Dental Reforma, billing@dentareforma.mx, phone +52 55 2345 6789. Estimate is MXN 4,200 for a temporary crown + x-ray. Id prefer direct-pay if possible to avoid carrying cash.

Claims Team: Checklist for Direct Pay request (locale-specific):
- Signed provider estimate/invoice on clinic letterhead
- Provider tax ID (RFC) or local equivalent
- Bank details or invoice billing information (for payments)
- W-8/W-9 equivalent if the provider requests US docs (we handle via finance)
- Copy of the patient treatment plan/estimate

Claims Team: If provider can invoice us directly, ask them to send a signed invoice to claims@redwood.com with subject: "Direct Bill Request  Samir  Claim 1798765432". Otherwise we will issue a verification letter so they can release treatment and you can pay then submit for reimbursement.

Dental Billing - Clinica Dental Reforma: Hi Samir  we received your inquiry. We can bill Redwood directly but need an authorization letter from your employer and a signed clinic invoice. Please have Redwood email benefits@redwood.com and cc billing@dentareforma.mx. Also include our invoice reference so we can match.

People Ops: We can issue an authorization/verification letter. We will redact full policy numbers and include claim ref 1798765432 and our benefits phone. We will also start a Direct Pay ticket with Finance. ETA for the letter is 3 hours; Direct Pay approval may take 3-7 business days depending on documents.

Samir: Please send the letter to billing@dentareforma.mx and cc me (samir@redwood.com). Also can you include an English line-item translation? Their estimate is in Spanish.

People Ops: Will do. Also reminder: if you pay out-of-pocket we reimburse in USD using FX at service date. Keep receipt + card txn. For direct-pay, provider must include RFC and accepted bank details.

Benefits Bot: Tip: for Mexico providers, having RFC and CLABE (bank account number) speeds up direct billing. Use the benefits portal upload to tag "Direct Pay Request".

Claims Team: We created Direct Pay intake DP-179876-A and emailed Finance to review clinic RFC and bank details. We also sent a verification letter to billing@dentareforma.mx and cc'd you. Letter ID HR-179876-AUTO.

Dental Billing - Clinica Dental Reforma: Confirmed receipt of authorization letter. We will send a formal invoice to claims@redwood.com within 24 hours.

Samir: Thank you 10 really appreciate the fast turnaround. If they need anything else ping me here.

People Ops: Looping closed for now  we uploaded the verification letter to your portal folder and flagged the Direct Pay intake. Well update when Finance confirms payment or if the clinic asks for additional tax docs. :thumbsup:

Benefits Bot: Reminder: if you travel with planned dental care, pre-approve via the portal so clinics can be billed directly at time of service.
